notes:
BUILD 15
- Three new suits: Arctic Hazmat (blue, 95% rad, warm, tougher; only in crates in the snow), Tactical Hazmat (black, head + chest slots only, works with NVGs, 75% rad; craftable) and Scientist Hazmat (100% rad; only at the broadcast tower). Slots a suit shuts off are shaded.
- Scientists wear proper teal hazmat suits; more of them in the snow.
- Third person: V. Hold ALT to swing the camera freely.
- FEET slot with burlap shoes, hide boots and work boots.
- Sights: the gun sits just under the aim point with a fine dot, so every sight is usable; the bolt action has a real scope.
- Guns have real spread now, opening up the longer you hold the trigger and tighter down the sights or crouched.
- Map pins (click the map, right-click to remove) show on the compass with distance, and so do your helicopters.
- Scientists: steer round walls, head for where a shot came from, see further once alerted, hit a bit harder than build 14. Outpost turrets forget you when you die.
